name: Tacit v1.1.4
body:
Stable release. Release build,
- Fixed: Open folder could fail with "Couldn't open that" when the phone's file manager is not Android's own; Tacit no longer sends the file-access grant that Android refuses there
- Fixed: a folder quicklink opened the same way and failed the same way
- Fixed: Export, Import and the file and folder pickers closed Tacit on a phone with no file picker; they now say so
- Changed: when a folder or file can't be opened, the message says whether no app can show it or Android blocked it
- Note: installs over 1.1.3 in place (same signing key)
- Tested: emulators Android 14, 15, 16; not tested on a phone

name: Tacit v1.1.3
body:
- Fixed: a snippet with an unusable date format such as {date:today is dd}, or one that needs a time zone, crashed Tacit when you ran it; the placeholder now stays as typed
- Fixed: a quicklink date format that needs a time zone crashed when opened; it now falls back to the ISO date and the editor refuses it
- Fixed: a failure in the encrypted clipboard store could end the app from the background clipboard thread; the history now simply isn't saved and nothing is written unencrypted
- Fixed: a backup that held a setting of the wrong type could make Tacit crash on every start; settings now fall back to their defaults
- Fixed: a damaged backup could apply half of itself before failing; it now changes nothing unless the whole file is readable
- Fixed: Open folder on a file stored on an SD card or USB drive opened the phone's main storage instead of that folder
- Fixed: {clipboard} in a snippet was empty unless clipboard history was on; it now reads what is on the clipboard when you run the snippet
- Fixed: the calculator could stall or crash on very long input; input over 400 characters is ignored
- Changed: when a row, menu action or folder can't be opened, Tacit now says so instead of doing nothing
- Note: installs over 1.1.2 in place (same signing key)
- Tested: emulators Android 14, 15, 16; not tested on a phone

name: Tacit v1.1.2
body:
- Fixed: opening a file or a video started the viewer inside Tacit's own task, so when a player finished and closed itself it could take Tacit down with it, and Home could cut the player off; every outside app now starts in its own task
- Fixed: a file that could not be opened did nothing; Tacit now says the file no longer exists or that no app can open it
- Fixed: the file provider now refuses anything but reads and reports a missing file properly, so viewers that probe a file get a clear answer
- Note: installs over 1.1.1 in place (same signing key)
- Tested: emulators Android 14, 15, 16; not tested on a phone

name: Tacit v1.1.1
body:
- Fixed: Uninstall in an app's long-press menu did nothing; it now opens the system dialog, removes the right copy of a work or Private Space app, and is left out for system apps
- Added: Create quicklink on a typed web address, email or phone number
- Changed: Save as snippet on a clipboard row confirms, skips a copy that already exists, and is not offered for a hidden clip
- Fixed: the flashlight no longer shows "Copied"; App info no longer crashes on an app that was just removed
- Fixed: a CSV saved by a spreadsheet no longer imports its header row; importing a snippets file twice no longer duplicates snippets
- Changed: Export everything and the CSV exports and imports say whether they worked, and a failed backup import says so
- Changed: the Work and Private labels are translated; the letter strip shows the letter under your thumb; with Animations on the drawer fades in; a refresh no longer redraws an unchanged drawer
- Changed: the selected row is easier to see in both themes, and the light theme's grey text is a little darker
- Note: installs over 1.1.0 in place (same signing key)
- Tested: emulators Android 14, 15, 16; not tested on a phone

name: Tacit v1.1.0
body:
Stable release. Release build, signed outside GitHub.
- Added: the first file search shows "Indexing files… N found" with early results, and the file index refreshes when you open Tacit or Settings
- Added: quicklinks to a screen inside another app (pick the app, then the screen), a Settings explorer, custom intent quicklinks with a Try button, Legacy shortcut, and quicklink icons (standard, the app's icon, or letters)
- Added: when Tacit is the home app, a shortcut pinned from another app asks to be added to Tacit, and Remove from Tacit takes it out again
- Added: Compact is a dense row (48 dp, subtitle on the same line); contact buttons that don't fit a narrow screen move into a More button; screen reader labels for the letter strip and the drawer tabs
- Fixed: Home no longer crashes Tacit when the result list is empty; WhatsApp buttons and app icons follow installs, removals and updates; a pinned shortcut follows its quicklink's rename; Import asks first and then applies everything at once
- Changed: a new app icon, the letter t whose foot turns into the Enter arrow, for the launcher, the themed icon, the Quick Settings tile, the widget and the first-run card
- Changed: search skips items that cannot match, with the same results; app icons are drawn on a thread of their own; touching the Apps button draws the first icons before the drawer opens; file search and scans are faster; one refresh per burst of app events
- Changed: the file index is stored in a new format and rebuilds once after the update; quicklinks gain an icon column that older builds ignore; backup format 2 carries the icons and format 1 files still import
- Kept: the app drawer stays opt-in and off by default, with no Files tab (decision 85)
- Note: a phone with a beta build must uninstall it first (different signing key); export settings first. A phone on 1.0.0 updates in place.
- APK: debug +193,149 B, release +59,136 B (compared with 1.0.0)
- Tested: emulators Android 14, 15, 16; since 1.0.0 112 new device tests and 158 new unit tests; not tested on a phone
